reconciliation.finding: Dashboard core has 31 published regular-issue papers across Vol. 47 Nos 1-4. The local catalog records 38 articles tagged with year 2025. Cross-referencing shows 25 of the 38 catalog articles were published in Vol. 47 (2025), while 13 were early online appearances published in Vol. 48 (2026) regular issues. Additionally, 6 papers published in Vol. 47 (2025) carry year 2024 in the catalog (25 + 6 = 31). Local catalog assigns year based on OJS metadata/submission timestamps rather than journal issue volume publication dates.

Both sources record exactly 24 articles. However, their composition differs: in dashboard-vjs-core.json, all 24 are published papers across Vol. 48 Nos 1-3. In the local catalog, 10 belong to Vol. 48 regular issues (Nos 2-3) and 14 are Online First advance articles. The remaining 14 published papers of Vol. 48 are tagged with year 2025 in the catalog (13 papers) or uncatalogued (1 paper, DOI 10.15625/2615-9783/24030).

comparison.differenceExplanation: Scopus indexed VJES starting in 2018; pre-2018 documents were not in Scopus source profile (only 31 counted). Local catalog includes 169 retrospective articles and matched 211 incoming citations.
Scopus source profile indexed 54 documents in window. Local catalog includes 164 articles with full retrospective coverage.
Official Scopus has 357 citations and 115 documents. Local self-calculation has 383 citations and 129 denominator articles.
Official Scopus has 421 citations and 117 documents. Local self-calculation has 444 citations and 129 denominator articles.

Official CiteScore 2025 was finalized by Scopus on 2026-05-05 with 604 citations and 122 documents (ratio 4.95 -> 5.0). Local self-calculation as of 2026-10-19 export yields 566 citations and 129 catalog denominator articles (ratio 4.39). Difference stems from Scopus citation window calculation date vs local citation matching export date and inclusion of Online First articles in catalog denominator.
Official CiteScoreTracker snapshot dated 2026-10-05 records 502 citations and 108 documents (ratio 4.6). Local self-calculation tracker has 518 citations and 124 denominator articles (ratio 4.18).

Local 4-year cs4 values are self-calculated ratios from local citation matching and catalog article records, NOT official Scopus CiteScore or Tracker values. They must be clearly labeled as self-calculated.

Source Scopus CSV filenames (VJES.csv and VJCH.csv) lack embedded export dates. While filesystem modification dates are 2026-10-19, filesystem timestamps are not verified source retrieval dates. Metadata updatedAt records processing date (2026-10-19).
Catalog retrieval timestamps are not recorded. Catalogs contain no issue records; article years reflect OJS metadata/submission timestamps rather than strict issue volume publication dates.
Future-year 2027 records (VJES: 3 docs / 3 edges; VJC: 11 docs / 11 edges) represent advance online/in-press citations and must NOT be published as current final annual figures.
2026 observations are Year-To-Date (YTD) partial counts, not full calendar-year metrics.

Search-hit rows lacking confirmed citations to catalog articles (123 for VJES, 1,153 for VJC) and virtual external references (202 for VJES, 1,093 for VJC) were excluded per the citation audit contract.
No raw CSV rows, author EIDs, or personal credentials are included in this output. All hashes represent immutable input files.
